record.title: Burundi national COVID border reclosure with phased reopening
record.scope: National land/water passenger restrictions; first reopening at Gatumba
record.direction: Passenger crossing in both directions affected.
record.enforcement: Official bulletin and on-site ABP/SOS reports establish Gatumba reopening.
record.consequences: Testing fees were reported by small traders as barriers to using reopened crossing.
record.uncertainty: Current phases distinguish Gatumba 1 June and Kobero/Mugina 14 June 2021. January 11 is a selected policy segment; earlier 2020 Gatumba closure and interim reopening remain unresolved. Cargo exempt; repatriation passage may also have occurred and must not be treated as complete impermeability.

historical.duration_note: Calendar-date difference to the stated partial reopening for the specified category and crossing; not exact hours or universal closure. 141 days applies only to non-exempt ordinary passenger movement at Gatumba, from January 11 to its June 1 partial reopening; other Burundi land/water crossings and exempt goods are excluded.
